clauses.title: Radiated emissions, 30-230 MHz
clauses.requirement: Radiated disturbance must not exceed 30 dBuV/m measured at 10 m for Class B equipment.

clauses.title: Radio spurious emissions
clauses.requirement: Spurious emissions in the transmit band must not exceed -36 dBm.

clauses.title: Electrical safety standard
clauses.requirement: Equipment must be assessed against BS EN 62368-1.

clauses.title: Conformity marking
clauses.requirement: Product must bear the UKCA marking and the manufacturer's address.
